title: A colour can be a blend of two colours
body:
A colour in acre is a literal such as `#C26A7A` or a `let` name that stands for one. Nothing computes a colour from others.

decade's proposed palette makes most of its shades as blends. For example, an agent card's fill is the theme's `red` 15% of the way from `background`. To draw that today, a script outside the figure works out the hex value and the figure holds the result. The figure then no longer shows where the value came from, and a change to the theme means running the script again.

## Proposal

A colour value can be a blend of two colours by a fraction, written in the plainest form the parser already reads, for example `(mix background red 0.15)`. Either colour may be a literal or a `let` name. Log the form chosen on the language design issue.
